result.title: When can an interpretability claim be trusted? Stability and certification of feature dimensionality, ridge leverage and the feature recovery rate
result.comment: 70 pages. Also archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23842568. The AI use statement is in the paper
result.summary: Interpretability tools increasingly support safety claims, such as that a sparse dictionary has recovered most of a model's features. Such claims rest on measurements with arbitrary thresholds, and small changes to the model weights, a different training seed or a different threshold can reverse them. We study two widely used measurements in toy models and synthetic dictionaries with known ground truth: the feature dimensionality of Elhage et al. and the feature recovery rate (FRR) with a cosine threshold. We characterize exactly where feature dimensionality is discontinuous and replace it with a regularized (ridge) version with sharp stability bounds: the ridge leverage score changes by at most $3\sqrt{3}/(8\sqrtλ)$ times the operator-norm change of the weights, and this constant cannot be improved; for the regularized dimensionality the stability constant grows like $ρ/4$ in the scale $ρ=R/\sqrtλ$, with explicit upper and lower bounds. We also prove certificates stating when a claim "feature $i$ is recovered" must survive a given change of the dictionary. The certificates held in every test and are informative for small perturbations, but certify no feature non-trivially across independently trained dictionaries; at the standard threshold, whether a feature counts as recovered changed with the training seed for 55 percent of features. Experiments use toy models only. The proofs, code and text were drafted by AI agents directed by the authors and checked by an independent blind AI reviewer and by numerical tests; the authors take full responsibility for the content.

AI.brief_summary: 在已知真值的玩具模型与合成字典上考察特征维度、特征恢复率（FRR）等可解释性度量的不连续性，提出 ridge leverage 版本并给出权重扰动下的稳定性界，以及「特征 i 已被恢复」何时必须成立的认证条件。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「度量是否稳定、结论能否认证」的视角可能可供核查 LVR 中「latent 是否保留某特征/内容」这类判断对阈值与随机种子的敏感性；但实验仅限玩具模型且非多模态，与推理期 latent 状态的迁移性有待验证。
